details:
No Travelers Aboard

About the Project

No Travelers Aboard is a pixel-art space mission design game developed for the 2026 NASA International Space Apps Challenge.

The project explores the process of designing uncrewed payloads for space missions through an interactive gaming experience. Players are presented with a specific mission and must create a suitable payload to meet its requirements. Once the design is completed, the game evaluates whether the payload is capable of fulfilling the mission requirements.

The goal is to make aspects of space mission planning more engaging and accessible by turning engineering-related decisions into an interactive experience.

Challenge Connection

No Travelers Aboard was developed in response to Challenge 13: Space Mission Design Game.

The challenge encourages participants to create interactive games that introduce players to the complexities of space mission design and the engineering decisions that influence mission outcomes.

Our project approaches this challenge through uncrewed payload design, allowing players to explore how payload choices relate to the requirements of a particular mission.

Technologies and Development Tools

Godot Engine

Godot was used as the primary game engine for developing No Travelers Aboard, implementing its gameplay mechanics, and bringing the different elements of the game together.

Aseprite

Aseprite was used to create the game's pixel-art sprites and visual assets. All original sprites and artwork were created by me.

AI Tools and Assistance

ChatGPT (OpenAI) was used as an AI-assisted tool during the development of No Travelers Aboard.

It was used for:

  • Development Guidance: Providing explanations, suggestions, and guidance during the game development process.
  • Game Writing: Assisting with writing and refining in-game texts, descriptions, and other written content.

ChatGPT served as an assistant throughout the process, while the game's design, artwork, and development were carried out using the tools described above.

Credits and Acknowledgements

  • Game Development: Godot Engine
  • Pixel Art and Sprites: Aseprite
  • AI Assistance: ChatGPT by OpenAI

Developed for the 2026 NASA International Space Apps Challenge.
